name: Installation & Commissioning
shortDescription: Professional installation and commissioning to ensure reliable compressor performance.
fullDescription: Correct placement, ventilation, electrical readiness, piping and start-up checks are essential for safe and dependable compressor operation.
serviceScope: FirstAir supports site-readiness review, equipment placement, connection checks, operating-parameter verification and customer handover.
imageAlt: Industrial compressor installation and commissioning support

process.title: Site Review
process.description: Review space, ventilation, electrical supply, piping and access.

process.title: Installation Support
process.description: Coordinate placement and verify installation requirements.

process.title: Commissioning
process.description: Verify start-up, pressure, controls and operating conditions.

process.title: Handover
process.description: Record commissioning data and explain routine operation.

name: Preventive Maintenance
shortDescription: Planned maintenance programs designed to maximize compressor reliability and equipment life.
fullDescription: Preventive maintenance aligns inspections, consumables and service work with operating hours and actual site conditions.
serviceScope: FirstAir helps plan recurring inspection and service activities, maintain records and coordinate genuine replacement parts.
imageAlt: Preventive maintenance for an industrial air compressor

process.title: Equipment Review
process.description: Capture model, operating hours, condition and maintenance history.

process.title: Maintenance Plan
process.description: Define inspection and replacement activities around the duty cycle.

process.title: Scheduled Service
process.description: Complete agreed work using appropriate parts and procedures.

process.title: Service Record
process.description: Document observations, work completed and follow-up recommendations.

name: Breakdown Support
shortDescription: Technical assistance to minimize downtime and restore production quickly.
fullDescription: When compressor problems interrupt production, clear equipment information and operating symptoms help the service team prioritize diagnosis and response.
serviceScope: FirstAir captures the fault condition, equipment identity, location and operational impact before coordinating technical support and corrective action.

process.title: Request Triage
process.description: Capture model, serial details, alarm information and production impact.

process.title: Technical Review
process.description: Review symptoms and determine the appropriate response path.

process.title: Corrective Support
process.description: Coordinate remote guidance, site service or required parts.

process.title: Closure Review
process.description: Record the action and identify preventive follow-up work.

name: Genuine Spare Parts
shortDescription: Genuine replacement parts to maintain compressor performance and reliability.
fullDescription: Correct part identification helps protect compressor performance, service life and maintenance quality.
serviceScope: FirstAir uses equipment model, serial information and part requirements to support identification and supply enquiries.
imageAlt: Genuine industrial compressor spare parts support

process.title: Equipment Identification
process.description: Provide compressor model, serial number and site details.

process.title: Part Requirement
process.description: Share part numbers, descriptions or supporting photographs.

process.title: Verification
process.description: Confirm compatibility and required quantities.

process.title: Supply Coordination
process.description: Coordinate quotation and fulfilment through the appropriate channel.

name: Annual Maintenance Contracts
shortDescription: Annual Maintenance Contracts tailored to operating requirements.
fullDescription: An AMC provides a structured framework for recurring compressor inspections, planned service and maintenance coordination.
serviceScope: FirstAir reviews the installed equipment, operating pattern, service history and site expectations before proposing an appropriate maintenance scope.
imageAlt: Annual maintenance contract support for compressor equipment

process.title: Installed Base Review
process.description: Record equipment, operating hours and current condition.

process.title: Scope Definition
process.description: Agree service frequency, coverage and responsibilities.

process.title: Planned Visits
process.description: Complete scheduled inspection and maintenance activities.

process.title: Performance Review
process.description: Review service history and update future actions.

name: Energy Audit
shortDescription: Identify energy losses and opportunities to improve compressed-air system efficiency.
fullDescription: Compressed-air efficiency depends on actual demand, generation pressure, controls, leaks, distribution losses and operating practices.
serviceScope: FirstAir reviews system information and operating requirements to identify practical opportunities for pressure optimization, demand matching and system improvement.

process.title: System Discovery
process.description: Collect compressor, operating-hour, pressure and production information.

process.title: System Review
process.description: Assess demand patterns, pressure settings and potential losses.

process.title: Opportunity Analysis
process.description: Identify practical efficiency and optimization actions.

process.title: Recommendation
process.description: Present prioritized improvement opportunities and next steps.
